Para obter um token:

  1. Inicie sessão na sua instância do Ntfy.
  2. Clique na conta
  3. Vai abaixar, nos tokens de acesso e clique no ícone do botão para copiar seu Token ou CRIAR ACESSO TOKEN se você não tiver
  4. Por favor, preste atenção ao tempo de expiração ao copiar/criar um Token.
  4. Copie seu token de acesso e cole-os nos campos abaixo.
Send a notification with a file from you: Send a notification with a file from your flow attached. ntfy.sh accepts files up to 2 MB without an account; self-hosted servers allow 15 MB by default.
Replace a notification already sent (or: Replace a notification already sent (or still scheduled) with new content, e.g. a progress update. Fields left empty are not copied from the original. Requires ntfy server v2.16.0 or later.
Mark a notification as read and dismiss: Mark a notification as read and dismiss it from phones and the web app. Requires ntfy server v2.16.0 or later.
Remove a notification from phones and th: Remove a notification from phones and the web app, or cancel a scheduled one before it is delivered. Requires ntfy server v2.16.0 or later.
Read messages that the ntfy server has c: Read messages that the ntfy server has cached for one or more topics. A message sent a few seconds ago may not be listed yet.
List messages that are scheduled for lat: List messages that are scheduled for later delivery and have not been delivered yet. A message scheduled a few seconds ago may not be listed yet.
Publish a notification to a ntfy topic w: Publish a notification to a ntfy topic with typed fields.
Get the ntfy account behind the connecti: Get the ntfy account behind the connection, with its limits and usage today.
Get the total number of messages the ntf: Get the total number of messages the ntfy server has published and its current message rate.
Check that the ntfy server on the connec: Check that the ntfy server on the connection is up and accepts the connection's token.
Check whether a file uploaded with a not: Check whether a file uploaded with a notification is still on the ntfy server, and its size.
Make a custom API call to a specific end: Faça uma chamada de API personalizada para um ponto de extremidade específico
Title: Título
The topic/channel to send the notificati: O tópico/canal para o qual enviar a notificação, por exemplo, test1
A prioridade da notificação (1-5). 1 é a prioridade mais baixa.
The absolute URL to your icon, e.g. http: A URL absoluta para seu ícone, por exemplo, https://example.com/communityIcon_xnt6chtnr2j21.png
Add Action buttons to notifications, see: Adicione botões de ação às notificações, veja https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/#action-buttons
You can define which URL to open when a: Você pode definir qual URL abrir quando uma notificação é clicada, veja https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/#click-action
Let ntfy send messages at a later date,: Deixe o ntfy enviar mensagens em uma data posterior, por exemplo, 'amanhã, 10am', veja https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/#agendamento de entrega
Public URL of a file to attach, e.g. htt: Public URL of a file to attach, e.g. https://example.com/report.pdf. ntfy does not download it; the apps link to it.
Name shown for the attachment, e.g. repo: Name shown for the attachment, e.g. report.pdf. Only used together with an attachment.
Render the message as Markdown (supporte: Render the message as Markdown (supported in the web app and on Android).
Also send the notification to this email: Also send the notification to this email address, e.g. jane@example.com. ntfy.sh allows 5 emails a day without an account; with an access token, ntfy.sh only sends to addresses verified in the account settings.
Also read the message out in a phone cal: Also read the message out in a phone call to this number, e.g. +12223334444, or "yes" for your first verified number. Needs a paid ntfy.sh plan (or a self-hosted server with Twilio) and a verified number.
Your own ID for this notification, e.g. backup-job-42, so later steps can update, clear or delete it. Letters, digits, "-" and "_". Needs ntfy server v2.16.0+.
Leave empty to let the server cache the: Leave empty to let the server cache the message (default), so it can be fetched later. "Do not cache" delivers it only to clients connected right now.
Leave empty to also push through Firebas: Leave empty to also push through Firebase (default, needed for instant delivery on Google Play Android apps). "Do not forward" skips Firebase.
The topic name, e.g. backups_home. 1-64: The topic name, e.g. backups_home. 1-64 characters: letters, digits, "-" and "_". Anyone who knows a public topic name can read it, so pick a hard-to-guess name.
The file to attach, e.g. the output of a: The file to attach, e.g. the output of a previous step.
Name shown for the file, e.g. report.pdf: Name shown for the file, e.g. report.pdf. Defaults to the file's own name.
Notification body, up to 4,096 bytes. Le: Notification body, up to 4,096 bytes. Leave empty and ntfy shows "You received a file: <file name>".
Optional notification title, e.g. \"Back: Optional notification title, e.g. "Backup finished". Defaults to the topic URL in the apps.
How urgently the phone should alert. Lea: How urgently the phone should alert. Leave empty for the default (3).
Tags shown with the notification. Tags t: Tags shown with the notification. Tags that match an emoji short code (e.g. warning, white_check_mark, rotating_light) are shown as that emoji.
Web page or app link opened when the not: Web page or app link opened when the notification is tapped, e.g. https://example.com/orders/42
Schedule delivery for later: a duration: Schedule delivery for later: a duration (30m, 2h, 1 day), a Unix timestamp or natural language like 'tomorrow, 10am'. Between 10 seconds and 3 days on default servers.
The notification to replace: the Message: The notification to replace: the Message ID returned when it was sent, or the Sequence ID you gave it, e.g. backup-job-42.
The new notification body, up to 4,096 b: The new notification body, up to 4,096 bytes, e.g. "Download 50% done".
URL of a JPEG or PNG image used as the n: URL of a JPEG or PNG image used as the notification icon, e.g. https://example.com/icon.png
Up to 3 buttons as a JSON array, e.g. [{: Up to 3 buttons as a JSON array, e.g. [{"action":"view","label":"Open","url":"https://example.com"}]. Types: view, http, broadcast, copy. See https://docs.ntfy.sh/publish/#action-buttons
The notification to clear: the Message I: The notification to clear: the Message ID returned when it was sent, or the Sequence ID you gave it, e.g. backup-job-42.
The notification to delete or cancel: th: The notification to delete or cancel: the Message ID returned when it was sent, or the Sequence ID you gave it, e.g. reminder-42.
One topic, or several separated by comma: One topic, or several separated by commas, e.g. alerts,backups_home. Letters, digits, "-" and "_" only.
How far back to read: a duration (2h), a: How far back to read: a duration (2h), a Unix timestamp, a message ID (messages after it), "latest" or "all". Defaults to 12h.
Only return messages with any of these p: Only return messages with any of these priorities. Leave empty for all.
Only return messages that have all of th: Only return messages that have all of these tags, e.g. backup.
Only return messages whose title is exac: Only return messages whose title is exactly this text.
Only return messages whose body is exact: Only return messages whose body is exactly this text.
Also return the message_clear and messag: Also return the message_clear and message_delete events created by Clear/Delete Notification.
Maximum number of messages to return (ne: Maximum number of messages to return (newest first), 1-1000. Defaults to 100.
Notification body, up to 4,096 bytes, e.g. "Backup finished in 4m 12s". ntfy uses "triggered" when empty (or "You received a file: <name>" with an attachment).
Whole number 1 (min) to 5 (max, urgent). Leave empty for the default 3.
Deliver only to clients connected right: Deliver only to clients connected right now; the message cannot be fetched later. Cannot be combined with Delay.
Skip Firebase push (Google Play Android: Skip Firebase push (Google Play Android apps then only get it while connected).
ID of the message the file was uploaded: ID of the message the file was uploaded with, e.g. TCZJOKUErDsd (the "id" returned by Send File). A trailing file extension such as .txt is ignored.
Authorization headers are injected autom: Os cabeçalhos de autorização são inseridos automaticamente a partir da sua conexão.
Habilitar para arquivos como PDFs, imagens, etc.
On a failed request, output the error in: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: u: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
Follow 3xx redirects instead of returnin: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
HEAD: CABEÇA
Triggers when a message is published to: Triggers when a message is published to a ntfy topic. Needs the server to cache messages (ntfy.sh keeps them 12 hours); messages sent with "Do not cache" are never seen.
Only trigger for messages with any of th: Only trigger for messages with any of these priorities. Leave empty for all.
Only trigger for messages that have all: Only trigger for messages that have all of these tags, e.g. backup.
